RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: Generate exactly one standalone figure. Render visible words only from exact_* fields in layout_and_content_blocks. Preserve all Chinese labels, D0/D1, minus signs, future-time symbols and punctuation exactly.
All canvas and box fills are WHITE #FFFFFF. Activate only #1B3A5C and #2E6B9E chromatic borders, with neutral gray. Text is #333333. Geometric anchors and arrows are #4D4D4D.
All three comparison panels have identical size, border color and weight, the same sample marker locations per column, and different pairings only. Do not imply any panel performs best.

Use simple native editable tables, open circles, straight pairing lines, orthogonal flow connectors and brackets. All conceptual sample markers are nonnumeric and labeled collectively as non-measured.
All forward connectors are solid arrows. Pairing segments inside panels have no arrowheads and are not causal or statistical effect estimates.
NO emojis, NO lock/fire/lightning icons, NO 3D rendering, NO complex semantic icons, NO gradients, NO shadows, NO maps, NO photographs.
NO measured scores, percentages, numerical sample values, confidence intervals, significance stars, achieved performance, outcome badges or fabricated datasets.
Do not draw calibrated C2 intervals as the source of the shared samples; the source is the original monotonic quantile grid.

Complete historical out-of-sample error vectors provide ranks only; all horizon labels must have arrived. Weather matching uses information known at each historical issuance and at the current issuance.
D0 is the primary overall-minus-independent Brier comparison; D1 is the prespecified secondary weather-minus-overall Brier comparison. Never swap them.
Probability scoring and offline alerting are parallel branches. Do not threshold probabilities before Brier scoring or choose thresholds using test outcomes.
Do not add text not present in exact_* fields; captions, grounding, metadata, index arrays, coordinates and formulas remain off-figure.
Preserve readability at 155mm final width, preferably 10pt main labels and 9pt notes. Simplify geometry or spacing before shrinking text.
caption_note: Each comparison panel depicts two future endpoints and three abstract sample markers per endpoint. This illustrative marker count is not M; the actual trajectory count remains a separate tentative design.

All horizons share identical marginal sample multisets across groups; reordering changes only within-row temporal pairings. No residual addition, separate marginal resampling or group-specific clipping is permitted.

Historical errors come from rolling holdout forecasts after complete trajectory truth has arrived. Weather conditioning matches current known weather to the conditions known at the corresponding historical issuance; sparse groups revert to the overall template.

The study concerns endpoint net change, not maximum within-window slope. Tentative primary event: future 60-to-90-minute net decline greater than 20% of capacity, with a 30-minute endpoint interval. Event magnitude and alert probability threshold are distinct quantities.

D0 = Brier(overall historical ranks) minus Brier(independent ordering). D1 = Brier(weather-conditioned historical ranks) minus Brier(overall historical ranks). D0 is primary and D1 prespecified secondary.

Paired uncertainty intervals fully below zero support the corresponding improvement; intervals crossing zero mean insufficient evidence. No actual interval or result is plotted. Primary/secondary comparisons are never exchanged according to test performance.

Use all valid unthresholded event probabilities for Brier and reliability diagnostics. Alert thresholds are fixed using validation data; test evaluation reports actual false alarms, precision, recall and lead time with prespecified event aggregation.
Direct increment/classification baselines, sample-count sensitivities and failure boundaries remain in the adjacent methods text; they are not additional matched-marginal panels.
This is a proposed research schematic. Xinjiang data authorization and collaboration remain unresolved; no empirical or deployed result is claimed.
caption_zh: C3技术路线：固定逐时距样本边际，比较独立排序、总体历史秩与天气条件历史秩。D0为总体历史秩减独立排序的Brier主比较，D1为天气条件历史秩减总体历史秩的预设次比较。样本列及配对线仅为结构示意，非实测结果；图示点数不代表实际轨迹数。历史模板只使用完整到齐的滚动留出误差，并按发布时已知天气匹配。未经阈值化的概率用于评分，告警阈值在验证阶段确定。
anchor: \textbf{对应研究内容三的路线。}输入内容二的边际预测与可用历史误差轨迹，构造同边际、不同时间依赖的轨迹并计算爬坡概率，与独立排序和直接增量方法对照。输出事件概率、可靠性分析与按事件聚合的告警记录，以概率评分和锁定告警规则下的实际效果验证，最后形成可回放的离线原型和适用条件说明。
